confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Manila price levels, not checked against live menus or listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors vary widely by district and season, so they are less certain. Bar and wine prices are inferred from typical local price levels rather than direct knowledge. FX value is taken from a search snippet attributed to rba.gov.au and was not confirmed against the F11 table itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Southeast Asian capital-city price levels, with Manila accommodation priced at the lower end relative to Bangkok and Ho Chi Minh City for basic and mid-tier rooms. Restaurant and drink anchors were set from general knowledge of local café and restaurant pricing.
